title: Authentication and account lifecycle launch readiness
goal: Make the complete production account lifecycle correct, tenant-safe, and verified in isolated staging

in: Signup, verification, login, logout, reset, onboarding, persona switching, sessions, redirect allowlists, and account deletion
Cross-persona and cross-tenant authorization and privacy-retention behavior
out: Unified settings rewrite owned by USER-003

acceptance_criteria: Every account lifecycle flow passes in isolated staging
Cross-persona and cross-tenant access attempts fail at the server data boundary
Redirects, sessions, reset tokens, deletion, and retention behavior match the approved security and privacy contracts

commands: Focused auth/privacy suites: 17 files, 76 tests passed
npx vitest run __tests__/auth: 9 files, 36 tests passed
npx vitest run __tests__/auth/account-delete-route.test.ts: 1 file, 11 tests passed
npx tsc -p /tmp/tsconfig.user005-storage.json --pretty false: blocked by pre-existing lib/auth/admin-context.ts organization identity type error
evidence: Production-readiness audit selected authentication, onboarding, personas, profiles, sessions, reset, and account deletion as core launch journeys requiring deployed certification.
Local implementation and focused tests only; no hosted staging claim
Typecheck interrupted after bounded window with no diagnostics; no hosted staging claim

Private-docs deletion now explicitly enumerates both <user-id>/ and staff-credentials/<user-id>/ while retaining the historical profile-images certification prefix. Elevated Storage operations construct paths only from the authenticated UUID plus validated one-segment list results, re-listing from offset zero in 1,000-object batches until each prefix is empty.

Focused tests prove more-than-1,000-object completion, later-batch list failure with auth deletion withheld, remainder-only retry, no-progress loop protection, current and legacy user-bound discovery, cross-user exclusion, unsafe-name fail-closed behavior, partial-failure reporting, and credential-free responses. No hosted Storage access or mutation was performed.
Official Supabase Storage documentation reviewed 2026-09-18: remove accepts explicit same-bucket paths; server-side service/secret keys bypass RLS and must never be exposed.
